completePay.title: Complete sale #{{id}}
completePay.intro: Enter the UZS and/or USD amount received. You may split payment across both currencies; mixed payments use the CB exchange rate.
completePay.prepaymentHint: This amount was received when the order was created
completePay.maxInCurrency: · Max total in {{currency}}: same amount · remainder may be collected in {{other}} or split across both (CB rate)
completePay.shortfallHint: Payment differs from the amount due (at the system exchange rate). Classify the difference as Discount and/or Currency Conversion Difference, or adjust the payment.
completePay.shortfallHintCredit: The payment is less than the amount due. Share the difference between Discount, On credit and/or Conversion Difference — all three can apply at once.
completePay.creditOption: On credit (record the remainder as the customer's debt)
completePay.creditAmountHint: Leave empty to put the whole remainder after the discount on credit.
completePay.errSharesExceedGap: The discount and the credit together are more than the unpaid remainder. Lower one of them.
completePay.errCreditNothingOwing: There is nothing left to put on credit — the payment covers the amount due.
completePay.creditDueDateHint: When the customer promised to pay. Reminders and the debt colours are counted from this date.
completePay.errCreditDueDate: Enter the payment date when On credit is selected.
completePay.errCreditWithFx: On credit already covers the whole unpaid remainder. Untick Currency Conversion Difference, or raise the payment.
completePay.confirmCreditTitle: The goods are leaving on credit.
completePay.confirmCreditEffect: The amount appears under Credit Sales. Profit is recognized as the cash arrives, once the cost has been recovered.
completePay.conversionDifferenceOption: Conversion difference (record remainder as conversion difference)
completePay.conversionDifferenceRemainder: The rest is recorded as additional profit: {{amount}}
completePay.additionalProfitOption: Additional profit (record the surplus as profit)
completePay.surplusHint: The payment is above the amount due. Classify the surplus as Conversion difference or Additional profit — otherwise it is added to the item's price.
completePay.errDiscountAmount: Enter the discount amount when Discount is selected.
completePay.changeOption: Give the remainder back as change
completePay.changeUnder: {{amount}} short of the change owed — the shop keeps that much. Classify it as Conversion difference or Additional profit.
completePay.changeOver: {{amount}} more than the change owed — the payment will fall short of the amount due.
completePay.errChangeAmount: Enter the change amount in UZS and/or USD.
completePay.notesDiscountHint: Optional. Choosing Discount still records the remainder; add a note only if you want it on the completion record.
completePay.notesOptional: Optional when the entered payment equals or exceeds the amount due.
completePay.errRateLoading: Exchange rate is still loading. Try again in a moment.
completePay.errDispatchAmount: Enter the delivery / dispatch payment amount (or check dispatch setup).
completePay.errShortfall: Payment difference is not fully classified. Select Discount and/or Conversion Difference, enter the discount amount if needed, or adjust the payment.
completePay.errNothingEntered: No payment entered. Enter an amount, or choose one of: Discount, On credit, Conversion Difference or Bepul.
completePay.errExceedsDue: Payment cannot exceed the remaining amount due ({{due}} {{currency}} after advance).
completePay.confirmOverpayTitle: Payment entered is higher than amount due.
completePay.confirmOverpayBook: The extra amount will still be booked as collected sale payment.
completePay.confirmAdditionalProfitBook: The excess will be recorded as additional profit (not a currency conversion difference).
completePay.errCbuRate: Could not load CBU exchange rate.
completePay.errEnterPayment: Please enter at least one payment amount.
completePay.errExceedsDueFormatted: Payment cannot exceed the remaining amount due ({{amount}} after advance).
completePay.errExceedsDueAdvanceCbu: Payment cannot exceed the remaining amount due ({{amount}} after advance, at CBU rate).
completePay.confirmCbuRateUsdUzs: Based on CBU exchange rate: 1 USD = {{rate}} UZS
completePay.confirmCrossListed: This sale is listed in {{sc}}. Advance payment was already received.
completePay.confirmCrossRecording: You are recording {{payLabel}} in {{otherCurrency}}{{equiv}} as the balance payment.
completePay.giveawayHint: This item is being given away. The full {{amount}} {{currency}} is written off and the goods' cost is recorded as a loss.
completePay.confirmGiveawayTitle: This item is being given away free.
completePay.confirmGiveawayAmount: Nothing will be received. The full {{amount}} is written off.
completePay.confirmGiveawayEffect: The goods' cost is recorded as a loss and appears in the “Given away” total.

dispatch.title: Create dispatch
dispatch.typeHint: Dostavshik: assign your courier here. BTS: carrier logistics; delivery and payments are still tracked in the Dispatchers tab.
dispatch.paymentMade: Payment made (if unchecked, will be recorded as payable)
dispatch.errSelectDispatcher: Select a dispatcher for courier delivery.
dispatch.errNoDispatchers: No active dispatchers. Add one under Dispatchers.

batch.title: Multi-item sale (one customer)
batch.intro: Add one line per product. The customer and sale type and currency below apply to every line. Each line becomes a separate sale (status: pending — update in the list as usual).

completeFromOrder.title: Complete sale from order — Sale #{{id}}
completeFromOrder.partialQtyHint: Selling {{qty}} of the {{ordered}} ordered — the rest never arrived.
completeFromOrder.paymentHint: Payment (UZS and/or USD — mixed amounts use CB rate):
completeFromOrder.deliveryPaymentLater: Delivery sales are collected by the courier at settlement, so no payment is taken here. Record the money on the delivery steps, where any Discount or Currency Difference is classified.
completeFromOrder.remainingHint: · Do not exceed this in {{currency}}; you may collect the balance in {{otherCurrency}} (confirmation required).
completeFromOrder.errPrice: Selling price is required and must be greater than 0
completeFromOrder.successDispatch: Sale completed! Please enter dispatch information.

sellReserved.title: Complete reserved sale #{{id}}
sellReserved.intro: Enter the UZS and/or USD amount for the remaining balance.
sellReserved.discountHint: Payment is below the balance due. Select Discount to record the remainder, or collect more.
sellReserved.loadingCbu: Loading CB exchange rate for split payment…
sellReserved.errPayment: Please enter at least one payment amount.
sellReserved.errDiscount: Payment is below the balance due. Select Discount to record the remainder, or collect more.

deliverySettlement.allDone: All settlement steps are already recorded for sale #{{id}}.
deliverySettlement.step1Intro: Enter what the courier collected from the customer (UZS and/or USD; mixed amounts use the CB rate). Hand-off only — no shop cash movement yet.
deliverySettlement.step1Success: Payment received by dispatch has been recorded.
deliverySettlement.step2Intro: Enter what the courier remitted to the shop (UZS and/or USD — same rules as Complete & Pay). Books sale income and clears receivable where applicable.
deliverySettlement.step2NoPerm: Courier collection is recorded. Shop staff must record payment received by shop — dispatchers cannot book shop remittance or sale income.
deliverySettlement.step2Success: Payment received by shop has been recorded.
deliverySettlement.step3TitlePay: Pay for dispatch & complete sale — Sale #{{id}}
deliverySettlement.step3IntroPay: Pay the dispatch fee from shop balances (UZS and/or USD at CB rate). Marks the sale completed.
deliverySettlement.step3IntroFree: No dispatch fee payout is configured. Submit to mark the sale completed.
deliverySettlement.step3NoPerm: Courier steps are recorded. Shop staff must pay the dispatch fee (if any) and complete the sale — you cannot pay from company balances as a dispatcher.
deliverySettlement.step3SuccessPay: Pay for dispatch completed — sale is now completed.
deliverySettlement.errAmount: Enter at least one amount collected from the customer.
deliverySettlement.errDispatchFee: Enter at least one amount for the dispatch fee.
deliverySettlement.errDispatchCalc: Could not calculate dispatch payment total.
deliverySettlement.settlementFinished: Settlement complete — sale will finish when the shop records the last step
deliverySettlement.confirmStep1Note: This records courier hand-off only (no shop cash movement yet).
deliverySettlement.confirmStep3MismatchNote: Amount differs from dispatch on record — fee will be updated to match.
deliverySettlement.declineHint: Customer refused this item — no money collected; the goods stay with the courier.
deliverySettlement.step1TotalIntro: Enter what the customer handed over for the whole order — it is divided across the items by what each one still owes. The individual item amounts below can still be adjusted by hand.
deliverySettlement.step1ShortfallIncomplete: {{product}}: {{amount}} of the shortfall is still unaccounted for. Raise the discount, or also tick Currency Difference to absorb the rest.
deliverySettlement.step1ShortfallRequired: The courier collected less than the listed price. Classify the difference as Discount or Currency Difference before continuing.
deliverySettlement.step1PriceAdjustedNotice: "{{product}}": the courier collected more than the listed price — price adjusted from {{before}} to {{after}}.
deliverySettlement.step1ShortfallProposedDiscount: "{{product}}": the courier proposed {{amount}} as a discount (under-collected). Confirm using the checkbox below.
deliverySettlement.step1ShortfallProposedFx: "{{product}}": the courier proposed {{amount}} as a currency difference (under-collected). Confirm using the checkbox below.
deliverySettlement.step1ShortfallProposedFxOver: "{{product}}": the courier proposed the {{amount}} collected above the price as a currency difference (over-collected). Confirm using the checkbox below.
deliverySettlement.step1ShortfallProposedProfit: "{{product}}": the courier proposed the {{amount}} over-collected as additional profit. Confirm using the checkbox below.
deliverySettlement.step1SurplusSplitIncomplete: "{{product}}": the {{amount}} surplus is not fully split. Enter the conversion difference amount; it cannot exceed the surplus.
deliverySettlement.step1SurplusConfirm: "{{product}}": {{amount}} was collected above the price. Nothing was selected, so this is added to the item's price: {{before}} -> {{after}}.
deliverySettlement.step1SurplusConfirmHint: If this is not a price change, press Cancel and tick Conversion difference or Additional profit.
deliverySettlement.reimburseChangeNow: Pay the courier his change now ({{amount}})
deliverySettlement.reimburseChangeNowHint: The debt is recorded and closed here - it shows as paid in Payables.
deliverySettlement.reimburseChangeLaterHint: The debt stays open in Payables; settle it later with the Reimburse button.
deliverySettlement.step1AdvanceTitle: An advance was taken for this item
deliverySettlement.step2CollectionTitle: What the courier recorded at the door
deliverySettlement.step2CollectedGross: Collected from the customer (gross): {{amount}} — this is what he hands over
deliverySettlement.step2CourierOwnChange: Of which his own money, given as change: {{amount}}
deliverySettlement.step2ChangeOwedBack: Once you accept the payment, {{amount}} is owed back to him (pay it from Payables).
deliverySettlement.step1SurplusOptional: The courier collected more than the listed price. Classify the surplus as Conversion difference or Additional profit; if neither is selected, you will be asked to confirm the item's price before it changes.
deliverySettlement.errExceedsCourierCollection: The entered amount ({{entered}}) exceeds what the courier collected ({{collected}}).
deliverySettlement.errAmountForItem: Enter at least one amount for "{{product}}".
deliverySettlement.confirmDeclineWarning: The sale line will be cancelled. You will separately confirm the goods when they are physically back at the shop.
deliverySettlement.step2GroupTotalTitle: Combined total — {{count}} item(s) (accounted as one sale)
deliverySettlement.returnPendingIntro: These items were declined by the customer and are still with the courier. Confirm once they are physically back at the shop — stock is restored only then.
deliverySettlement.confirmReturnPrompt: Confirm "{{product}}" is back at the shop? Stock will be restored.
deliverySettlement.returnPendingNoPerm: Shop staff must confirm the return.

notifications.errSelectCustomer: Please select a customer before creating sales.
notifications.errAddLine: Add at least one line with a product selected.
notifications.errSellingPrice: Set a selling price for every line (pick a product to prefill it).
notifications.errLayerStock: Insufficient stock in the selected layer for product #{{pid}}: need {{need}}, have {{available}}.
notifications.errInventory: Insufficient inventory for product #{{pid}}: need {{need}}, have {{available}}.
notifications.errPkgNotInInventory: Package type "{{type}}" is not in inventory.
notifications.confirmCancelReserved: Are you sure you want to cancel this reserved sale? The item will be returned to inventory.
notifications.cancelReservedSuccess: Reserved sale cancelled successfully. Item returned to inventory.
notifications.confirmCancelSale: Cancel this in-progress sale? The sale record will be kept. Completed sales must use Returns instead.
notifications.confirmCancelSaleGroup: Cancel all {{count}} items in this multi-item sale? Every in-progress line will be cancelled. Completed sales must use Returns instead.
notifications.cancelSaleGroupSuccess: Cancelled {{count}} items in this multi-item sale.
notifications.errPkgInsufficient: Insufficient stock for package "{{type}}": need {{need}}, have {{have}}.
